newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca down as Roche bid hopes dwindle.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca down as Roche bid hopes dwindle.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc dropped on Wednesday as bid hopes faded following news that Switzerland's Roche Holding AG is to acquire U.S. food and beverage group Tastemaster, dealers said.
The stock was down 21-1/2p at 17.38-1/2 stg by 0951 GMT.
Dealers said the acquisition had quashed speculation that Roche would sell its fragrances and flavours business, raising finance for an acquisiton in the pharmaceutical sector.
"People are just saying that the chances of Roche bidding are looking a little more remote," said one market-maker.
Separately a report in the Financial Times said a presentation by Roche in Basle had left an impression that it favours a number of smaller acquisitions rather than a single blockbuster bid.
"There is a massive bid premium in Zeneca shares and we have just seen a little of that wiped out," another trader said.
